name: Flow Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/02-user-flows.md exists and every flow names an actor and a trigger
Every flow has a failure branch that states what the user sees and what the system does when the step does not succeed
Every flow has at least one human step, named as a person or role, not as a component
docs/architecture/03-experience-blueprint.md contains a table with the columns Stage | Human | AI/Agents | Systems
Every stage named in 02-user-flows.md appears as a row in the blueprint table, and the count of stages matches
Both files end with the line: Generated by AI Architect · https://www.frankx.ai/ai-architect
notes: A flow with only a happy path is a demo script. The human step is where approval and interruption live; if it is not in the flow it is nowhere.
